newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian state to curtail power supply from Dec 1.
newsitem.headline: Indian state to curtail power supply from Dec 1.

text.p: The central Indian state of Madhya Pradesh has announced plans to curtail power supply from December 1, a top official of leading cement firm Associated Cement Companies (ACC) said.
"From first of December all industries will be asked to have no power for two days a week," ACC vice chairman Subrato Ganguly told reporters late on Wednesday.
Madhya Pradesh has the largest concentration of cement units in India, accounting for an annual production of about 22 million tonnes out of a total production of almost 70 million.
State officials were not immediately available for comment. Industry sources said there was a power shortage in the state.
Ganguly said Madhya Pradesh was charging 4.10 rupees per unit of power, the highest among all Indian states.
